brief: From now on, my default study area is the 'Karst Valley' area in my main project — assume it unless I say otherwise. Now list what predictions I have there.

rubric.guidance: The user stated a standing preference ('from now on'). The agent must call olmoearth_remember with a sensible key (e.g. default_area) and a value naming the area (ideally with its discovered id). Not saving it, or saving unrelated task detail, scores 0.
The listing half of the brief must be scoped to the named area (discovered via tools, never an invented id), without re-asking the user which area they meant.
Nothing besides the stated preference is remembered — no API keys, no one-off tool output, no more than one olmoearth_remember call for this brief.
